package p

// The interface is ordinary and legal: no type parameters.
type Store interface {
	Get(id string) (any, error)
}

type PostgresStore struct{}

// The implementation tries to satisfy it with a generic method.
func (s PostgresStore) Get[T any](id string) (T, error) {
	var zero T
	return zero, nil
}

var _ Store = PostgresStore{}
